title: Add an audit trail using the in-house event bus correctly
prompt: The codebase has its own EventBus in src/eventbus.py with specific semantics documented in its docstrings. Implement src/audit.py: an AuditLog that records every order event as a immutable record, wired to the bus through the documented subscription API. AuditLog(bus) must subscribe to 'order.created', 'order.paid' and 'order.cancelled'; expose records() returning the events in the order received; expose detach() that unsubscribes cleanly using whatever the bus's subscribe() returns; and must not raise out of a handler, because the bus documents that a raising handler is unsubscribed. Do not modify src/eventbus.py and do not reach into its private attributes - use its public API only.
acceptance_criteria: AuditLog subscribes to exactly the three documented order topics.
records() returns received events in arrival order, as immutable snapshots.
detach() uses the token returned by subscribe() and stops further recording.
A malformed event does not raise out of the handler, so the subscription survives.
src/eventbus.py is unmodified and no private attribute of the bus is touched.
Publishing an unrelated topic records nothing.
